name: second-look
description: Checks a web page the way real visitors see it: phone widths, larger text turned on, cut-off buttons and words, broken links and JavaScript errors. Plain-English report.

scripts.test: node --test tests/*.test.mjs && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py'
scripts.postinstall: echo 'second-look: run `npx playwright install chromium` once if you have not already.'

author: Cody Green
